dataset.kind: synthetic, generated from cited evidence ranges
dataset.split: shuffled 60/20/20. A real historical dataset must use a TIME-based split; an i.i.d. shuffle over generated rows does not leak, but it also does not prove temporal generalisation.

evidence_anchors.tariff_volatility_months: SJEV-CASE-015 - Tariff volatility duration verdict (Columbus Consulting)

meta.disclosure: ADVISORY ONLY. This model supplies a duration PRIOR for scenario generation. It never produces a number that reaches a shared contract unless forecasting.enabled is set in config/settings.yaml, and even then A2 clamps it against configured bounds. The training rows are synthetic; the pipeline is real. No LLM is involved.
